findings.finding: Biopsafe (~50 MDKK annual revenue, 'good profitability', closed 2026-06-26) contributes its first full quarter in Q3 2026, roughly 18-19 MSEK of sales or ~3.7% of the Q3 2025 base, and the company says it adds to MedTech's growth and margin.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 acquired growth (XGX, LivAssured) plus 7% organic gave a beat and +12.3% on the day; Q1 2026 sales missed Redeye by ~6% and the stock still rose 2.3% on margin.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it was inside information on 26 June and Redeye's 22 July review updated estimates after it. What could be unpriced is only the margin: if analysts modelled Biopsafe at group-average margin and it runs higher, adj. EBITA lands a few MSEK above; the price would look different (no drift from 574 to 503 after Q2) if the market were extrapolating that.
findings.independence: Q2 report says the acquisition 'is expected to make a positive contribution to the business area's growth and margin' (https://storage.mfn.se/a4dc78b1-d7c7-403a-9225-7ee84803c9e2/medcap-interim-report-q2-2026.pdf) - same issuer, so not independent.

findings.finding: XGX Pharma closed on 2025-07-21, so it was already in the Q3 2025 base for ~10 of 13 weeks; the ~9 points of acquired growth seen in Q2 2026 fall to roughly 4-5 points, and headline sales growth should step down from 16% to the low teens even with organic held at 7%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 headline growth below Redeye's forecast (organic ~4%) still drew +2.3% because margins beat; slower headline growth has not been sold on its own here.
findings.why_not_priced: The analysts model it, but a 2-analyst name's tape and retail readers key on the headline growth figure in the release title; a visibly slower 'tillväxt' headline after three quarters of 15-21% could read as deceleration. If priced, there would be no reason to expect any headline effect; this is an inference and is sized small.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 report shows XGX in that quarter's 21% growth (https://mb.cision.com/Main/2678/4255229/3742454.pdf).

findings.finding: SEK was weaker against EUR and DKK through Q3 2026 than a year earlier (Yahoo monthly EUR/SEK ~11.1-11.3 vs ~10.9-11.05; DKK/SEK ~1.49-1.52 vs ~1.46-1.48), a translation tailwind of perhaps 1-2 points on sales, after FX already added ~1 point in Q2 (16% reported vs 15% FX-adjusted).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: no instance of FX moving this stock on a print found
findings.why_not_priced: A macro-to-company proxy that analysts usually fold in; small and largely priced. Filed because Q2 shows the transmission is real (the company's own FX-adjusted growth line).
findings.independence: Q2 2026 report: 'Adjusted for currency effects, net sales increased by 15 percent' vs 16% reported (https://storage.mfn.se/a4dc78b1-d7c7-403a-9225-7ee84803c9e2/medcap-interim-report-q2-2026.pdf).
